items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: And, uh, K-Tro, all them fellas in there from out front.

ctx.x: Ask him who Jesse Jackson had in his band.
See, who Jesse Jackson had in his band? Well, he used to have different fellas, you know. Doug Ernest, Dave, all them fellas like that. And, uh, K-Tro, all them fellas in there from out front.
Ask him if he knew, uh...

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: We couldn't play behind him... we had to tell him... we couldn't play, but he had to play by himself

ctx.x: He said, what about Big Kato and Little Kato? Oh, well, Little Kato. You know him, huh? You know what I'm talking about? He was a piano player. Both of them piano. But Little Kato, he was a musician. He could have been there. And that's when I told him to play all those ninth cards and six cards, you know, like that, and the minister cards, when they take a hat. We couldn't play behind him, you know what he'd be making. And after he kept on doing it, we had to tell him, you know, we couldn't play, but he had to…
Big Kato was blind. I know.
